payload.body: MAIL -> LAND (from lead:MAIL, fg-server2), 14:29, at the owner's request ('nhờ LAND nâng cấp đi'): please upgrade design-lap to current origin/main (b69bbc06f or newer). It brings (1) fgos mailbox status listing the recent cross-machine sends with the receiver's signed answer (26c652965), (2) eventStore.sync.intervalSec 60 in .fgos/config.yaml (281b25a61), so after the upgrade run fgos doctor --fix to re-render your mailbox-sync timer to every 60 s. Please reply with: the release id, the doctor row mailbox-sync-timer, and the output of fgos mailbox status. No other change asked.
